# Sync Code — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the broken desktop login with a 6-digit sync code generated by the WeChat mini-program and redeemed by the Electron desktop client, bound to the same `t_user.id` as the player's WeChat account — no secrets on the desktop, no admin in the loop.

**Architecture:** Two new backend endpoints (`POST /api/sync-code/generate` and `POST /api/sync-code/redeem`) backed by Redis. Mini-program profile page gains a "获取桌面同步码" modal. Electron `auth.ts` swaps `login(username, password)` for `redeemSyncCode(code)`. IPC channel name stays `auth:login`; payload type changes from `{username, password}` to `{code}`. A `ClientIpResolver` utility is extracted from `EarnedSalaryController` for per-IP rate limiting.

**Tech Stack:** Spring Boot 3.1.6 (MyBatis-Plus, Spring Data Redis, jjwt, Lombok), Vue 3 + Pinia + element-plus + axios + Electron safeStorage (desktop), native WeChat mini-program (wx.* APIs).

**Repo layout:** Three independent git repos:
- `D:\Front_Project\all\all_function_api` — Spring Boot backend
- `D:\Front_Project\all\local_skin_importer` — Electron + Vue 3 desktop
- `D:\Front_Project\all\wechat_rating_program` — WeChat mini-program

**Convention reminder:** Subagents must NOT `git commit` in any of these three repos — per project memory `nested-git-repo-under-front-project`, the user commits manually after subagent work lands.

**Commit batching hint:** Each task ends with a "User commits manually" step. The user typically prefers ONE combined commit per repo (per project memory). Recommended groupings:
- Backend (tasks 1-3): one commit `feat(sync-code): backend (ClientIpResolver, SyncCodeService, SyncCodeController)`.
- Backend deploy (task 4): no commit — only file copy + restart.
- Desktop (tasks 5-7): one commit `feat(sync-code): desktop (auth.ts, IPC, Login.vue)`.
- Mini-program (task 8): one commit `feat(sync-code): mini-program profile page`.

If the user prefers per-task commits instead, the per-task step 6/steps remain valid.

```java
package com.lolskin.common;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;

/**
 * Resolve originating client IP behind nginx. XFF first segment → X-Real-IP → getRemoteAddr().
 * Use ONLY where per-IP bucketing is needed; do NOT add server.forward-headers-strategy globally.
 */
public final class ClientIpResolver {

    private ClientIpResolver() {}

    public static String resolve(HttpServletRequest request) {
        String xff = request.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For");
        if (xff != null && !xff.isBlank()) {
            int comma = xff.indexOf(',');
            return comma >= 0 ? xff.substring(0, comma).trim() : xff.trim();
        }
        String real = request.getHeader("X-Real-IP");
        if (real != null && !real.isBlank()) return real.trim();
        return request.getRemoteAddr();
    }
}
```

```java
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;

import org.springframework.data.redis.core.script.RedisScript;

import java.time.Duration;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

class SyncCodeServiceTest {

    private StringRedisTemplate redis;
    private ValueOperations<String, String> ops;
    private JwtService jwtService;
    private UserMapper userMapper;
    private SyncCodeService service;

    @BeforeEach
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void setUp() {
        redis = mock(StringRedisTemplate.class);
        ops = mock(ValueOperations.class);
        when(redis.opsForValue()).thenReturn(ops);
        jwtService = mock(JwtService.class);
        userMapper = mock(UserMapper.class);
        service = new SyncCodeService(redis, jwtService, userMapper);
    }

    @Test
    void generateProduces6DigitCodeAndSetsLookupViaSetnx() {
        when(ops.setIfAbsent(anyString(), anyString(), any(Duration.class))).thenReturn(true);

        SyncCodeService.GenerateResult r = service.generate(42L);

        assertNotNull(r.code());
        assertEquals(6, r.code().length());
        assertTrue(r.code().matches("\\d{6}"));
        assertEquals(300, r.expiresInSec());
        verify(ops).setIfAbsent(startsWith("sync_code:lookup:"), eq("42"), eq(Duration.ofSeconds(300)));
    }

    @Test
    void generateRetriesOnCollisionUpTo5Times() {
        when(ops.setIfAbsent(anyString(), anyString(), any(Duration.class)))
            .thenReturn(false, false, false, false, true);

        SyncCodeService.GenerateResult r = service.generate(7L);

        assertNotNull(r.code());
        verify(ops, times(5)).setIfAbsent(anyString(), anyString(), any(Duration.class));
    }

    @Test
    void generateThrowsWhenAll5AttemptsCollide() {
        when(ops.setIfAbsent(anyString(), anyString(), any(Duration.class))).thenReturn(false);

        assertThrows(RateLimitedException.class, () -> service.generate(99L));
        verify(ops, times(5)).setIfAbsent(anyString(), anyString(), any(Duration.class));
    }

    @Test
    void redeemReturnsJwtWhenLuaReturnsUserId() {

        assertEquals("jwt-xyz", r.token());

        assertEquals("Alice", r.nickname());
```

```lua
-- KEYS[1] = sync_code:lookup:{code}
-- Returns: userId as string, or nil if code is invalid/expired
local userId = redis.call('GET', KEYS[1])
if not userId then return nil end
redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])
redis.call('DEL', 'sync_code:user:' .. userId)
return userId
```

`src/main/java/com/lolskin/service/SyncCodeService.java`:

```java
package com.lolskin.service;

import com.lolskin.entity.User;
import com.lolskin.exception.RateLimitedException;
import com.lolskin.mapper.UserMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.script.DefaultRedisScript;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.script.RedisScript;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.util.StreamUtils;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SyncCodeService {

    public static final int CODE_TTL_SECONDS = 300;
    public static final int COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 30;
    public static final int MAX_COLLISION_RETRIES = 5;
    public static final int LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD = 5;
    public static final int LOCKOUT_TTL_SECONDS = 600;

    private final StringRedisTemplate redis;
    private final JwtService jwtService;
    private final UserMapper userMapper;

    private final SecureRandom secureRandom = new SecureRandom();
    private final RedisScript<String> redeemScript = loadRedeemScript();

    public record GenerateResult(String code, int expiresInSec) {}
    public record RedeemResult(String token, Long userId, String nickname) {}

    public GenerateResult generate(Long userId) {
        String code = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_COLLISION_RETRIES; i++) {
            String candidate = String.format("%06d", secureRandom.nextInt(1_000_000));
            Boolean ok = redis.opsForValue().setIfAbsent(
                "sync_code:lookup:" + candidate,
                String.valueOf(userId),
                Duration.ofSeconds(CODE_TTL_SECONDS)
            );
            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(ok)) {
                code = candidate;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (code == null) {
            throw new RateLimitedException("服务繁忙,请重试");
        }
        return new GenerateResult(code, CODE_TTL_SECONDS);
    }

    public RedeemResult redeem(String code) {
        String userIdStr = redis.execute(
            redeemScript,
            List.of("sync_code:lookup:" + code)
        );
        if (userIdStr == null) return null;
        Long userId = Long.valueOf(userIdStr);
        User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
        if (user == null) {
            log.warn("sync-code redeem: userId={} not found in t_user", userId);
            return null;
        }
        String jwt = jwtService.generateToken(user.getId(), user.getOpenid());
        return new RedeemResult(jwt, user.getId(), user.getNickname());
    }

    private static RedisScript<String> loadRedeemScript() {
        try (var is = new ClassPathResource("scripts/sync_code_redeem.lua").getInputStream()) {
            String lua = StreamUtils.copyToString(is, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            return new DefaultRedisScript<>(lua, String.class);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("failed to load sync_code_redeem.lua", e);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.lolskin.controller;

import com.lolskin.common.ClientIpResolver;
import com.lolskin.common.Result;
import com.lolskin.dto.RedeemSyncCodeRequest;
import com.lolskin.exception.RateLimitedException;
import com.lolskin.exception.UnauthorizedException;
import com.lolskin.service.JwtService;
import com.lolskin.service.SyncCodeService;
import com.lolskin.vo.RedeemSyncCodeVO;
import com.lolskin.vo.SyncCodeVO;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.time.Duration;

/**
 * Sync code endpoints — see spec 2026-08-11-sync-code-design.md.
 * /generate gated by mini-program JWT; /redeem is public + per-IP rate-limited.
 */
@Slf4j
@Tag(name = "同步码", description = "小程序生成 6 位同步码,桌面端兑换 JWT")
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/sync-code")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SyncCodeController {

    private final SyncCodeService syncCodeService;
    private final JwtService jwtService;
    private final StringRedisTemplate redis;

    @Operation(summary = "生成同步码(需要小程序 JWT)")
    @PostMapping("/generate")
    public Result<SyncCodeVO> generate(HttpServletRequest request) {
        Long userId = extractUserId(request);
        String cooldownKey = "sync_code:cooldown:" + userId;
        Boolean acquired = redis.opsForValue().setIfAbsent(
            cooldownKey, "1", Duration.ofSeconds(SyncCodeService.COOLDOWN_SECONDS));
        if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(acquired)) {
            throw new RateLimitedException("请稍后再试");
        }
        SyncCodeService.GenerateResult result = syncCodeService.generate(userId);
        return Result.success(new SyncCodeVO(result.code(), result.expiresInSec()));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "兑换同步码拿 JWT(公开,带 IP 限频)")
    @PostMapping("/redeem")
    public Result<RedeemSyncCodeVO> redeem(@Valid @RequestBody RedeemSyncCodeRequest dto,
                                            HttpServletRequest request) {
        String ip = ClientIpResolver.resolve(request);
        String failKey = "rate:redeem:fail:" + ip;
        String fails = redis.opsForValue().get(failKey);
        int failCount = fails == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(fails);
        if (failCount >= SyncCodeService.LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD) {
            throw new RateLimitedException("尝试次数过多,请 10 分钟后再试");
        }

        SyncCodeService.RedeemResult result = syncCodeService.redeem(dto.getCode());

        if (result == null) {
            redis.opsForValue().increment(failKey);
            redis.expire(failKey, Duration.ofSeconds(SyncCodeService.LOCKOUT_TTL_SECONDS));
            return Result.error(400, "无效或过期");
        }

        redis.delete(failKey);
        return Result.success(new RedeemSyncCodeVO(result.token(), result.userId(), result.nickname()));
    }

    private Long extractUserId(HttpServletRequest request) {
        String auth = request.getHeader("Authorization");
        if (auth == null || !auth.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException("未登录");
        }
        try {
            return jwtService.getUserId(auth.substring(7));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException("token 无效");
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Rewrite auth.ts**

Replace the entire `login()` function with `redeemSyncCode()`. Update the envelope type from `LoginEnvelope` to `RedeemEnvelope` (the local interface only has `code`/`data?.token`/`message` fields; `data.userId`/`data.nickname` are ignored — main returns only the token string).

```typescript
import axios from 'axios';
import { app, safeStorage } from 'electron';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import * as path from 'node:path';

const BACKEND_BASE_URL = 'http://101.34.210.254:8080';
const TOKEN_FILENAME = 'auth.bin';

interface RedeemEnvelope { code: number; data?: { token?: string }; message?: string }

const TOKEN_PREVIEW_LENGTH = 12;

function tokenFilePath(): string {
  return path.join(app.getPath('userData'), TOKEN_FILENAME);
}

export async function redeemSyncCode(code: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) throw new Error('码格式无效');
  const { data } = await axios.post<RedeemEnvelope>(
    `${BACKEND_BASE_URL}/api/sync-code/redeem`,
    { code },
    { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  );
  if (data.code !== 200 || !data.data?.token) {
    throw new Error(data.message ?? '兑换失败');
  }
  return data.data.token;
}

export function saveToken(jwt: string): void {
  if (!safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable()) {
    throw new Error('OS encryption unavailable; refusing to persist token in plaintext');
  }
  const enc = safeStorage.encryptString(jwt);
  fs.writeFileSync(tokenFilePath(), enc);
}

export function getStoredToken(): string | null {
  const p = tokenFilePath();
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) return null;
  try {
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(p);
    return safeStorage.decryptString(buf);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function clearStoredToken(): void {
  const p = tokenFilePath();
  if (fs.existsSync(p)) fs.unlinkSync(p);
}

export function getAuthStatus(): { loggedIn: boolean; tokenPreview: string | null } {
  const t = getStoredToken();
  if (!t) return { loggedIn: false, tokenPreview: null };
  return {
    loggedIn: true,
    tokenPreview: `${t.substring(0, TOKEN_PREVIEW_LENGTH)}...`
  };
}
```

```typescript
const code = ref<string>('');
const submitting = ref<boolean>(false);

async function onSubmit(): Promise<void> {
  if (submitting.value) return;
  errorMessage.value = null;

  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const err = e as { message?: string };
    errorMessage.value = err.message ?? '兑换失败';
  } finally {

  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Add handler in profile.js**

In `pages/profile/profile.js`, add `data` fields and handlers:

```javascript
data: {
  // ... existing fields ...
  syncCodeModalVisible: false,
  syncCodeState: 'idle',  // 'loading' | 'showing' | 'error' | 'expired'
  syncCode: '',
  syncCodeCountdown: 0,
  syncCodeExpiresAt: 0,
  syncCodeError: '',
},

onSyncCodeTap() {
  this.setData({
    syncCodeModalVisible: true,
    syncCodeState: 'loading',
    syncCode: '',
    syncCodeError: ''
  });
  const config = require('../../utils/config.js');
  const http = require('../../utils/request.js').default;

  http.post(config.API_PATHS.SYNC_CODE_GENERATE, {})
    .then((resp) => {
      if (resp && resp.code === 200 && resp.data && resp.data.code) {
        this.setData({
          syncCodeState: 'showing',
          syncCode: resp.data.code,
          syncCodeExpiresAt: Date.now() + (resp.data.expiresInSec || 300) * 1000
        });
        this._startSyncCodeCountdown();
      } else {
        this.setData({ syncCodeState: 'error', syncCodeError: (resp && resp.message) || '获取失败' });
      }
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      const msg = (err && err.message) || '网络错误';
      this.setData({ syncCodeState: 'error', syncCodeError: msg });
    });
},

_startSyncCodeCountdown() {
  if (this._syncCodeTimer) clearInterval(this._syncCodeTimer);
  this._syncCodeTimer = setInterval(() => {
    const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((this.data.syncCodeExpiresAt - Date.now()) / 1000));
    this.setData({ syncCodeCountdown: remaining });
    if (remaining <= 0 && this._syncCodeTimer) {
      clearInterval(this._syncCodeTimer);
      this._syncCodeTimer = null;
      this.setData({ syncCodeState: 'expired' });
    }
  }, 1000);
},

onSyncCodeCopy() {
  wx.setClipboardData({
    data: this.data.syncCode,
    success: () => wx.showToast({ title: '已复制', icon: 'success' })
  });
},

onSyncCodeClose() {
  if (this._syncCodeTimer) clearInterval(this._syncCodeTimer);
  this._syncCodeTimer = null;
  this.setData({ syncCodeModalVisible: false });
},
```
